_comment: MCP server configuration for Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and Kiro IDE.

_modes.local: Spawns a local Node.js process — use when running everything on your machine. Fastest for dev.
_modes.remote: Connects to Cloudflare Workers remote MCP — use in production for token efficiency (~80% fewer tokens). Requires cloudflare-mcp to be deployed.

video-pipeline-local._comment: LOCAL MODE: spawns node process. Use for development / when your machine does the rendering.

video-pipeline-remote._comment: REMOTE MODE (Cloudflare Workers): connect via URL. ~80% fewer tokens. Deploy cloudflare-mcp/ first.
